method: Intersect each inspected original BAG raster envelope with the exact region bounds. A broad variable-resolution overview may intersect without any surveyed native cells inside.
limitations: Not surveyed-area coverage, substrate, navigation, legal clearance, fish presence or a fishing spot.
Only original BAGs within the bounded audit are included; missing and larger files remain unassessed.

leads.hold_reason: This is a 2008 Crescent City harbor and approach survey. Its descriptive report identifies significant channel shoaling, numerous uncharted rocks along the southern offshore edge, and incomplete full-bottom coverage of the approach. The five eligible 4 m screen cells overlapping a predicted-hard polygon (about 80 square meters) cannot establish a natural fishing reef or a safe approach. Keep the survey for harbor-source review; do not promote it to a fishing target without a current chart, site-specific original-cell review and separate substrate evidence.
